Comment: Least-privilege policy for Apex's self-deploy path (packages/cicd-automation/src/lightsail-deployer.ts). Attach to a DEDICATED IAM user or role for the apex-service process. Do NOT run Apex on AWS root-account credentials: root cannot be scoped down, cannot be cleanly rotated, and this process exposes tools to 13 autonomous agents. Replace ACCOUNT_ID with the real account id.
